description:
A joint plan for up to 30 products sharing one cash floor, monthly budget,
credit facility and supplier capacity.

`profile["navigator"]["products"]` is the list of product rows (each with
`id`, `label`, `monthly_demand_units`, `monthly_spend_gbp` and optional
`unit_sell_price_gbp`, `starting_inventory_units`). Products are planned
together, not separately and summed. `which_product_lost` names which
product gave up units to hold a shared limit, and why;
`would_have_been_feasible_separately` names products that pass alone but
not together. `regime_state` and `corridor_id` as in `test_order`.

Figures carry a `provenance` stamp (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY or ESTIMATED; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names any figure only the caller holds. Information, not advice.
name: plan_products
title: Plan several products together
